reason: This plugin is a user-facing DSH Web GUI utility that changes approval workflow behavior by adding a session-level, per-mode grant in the approval dialog and by adding a short-lived guard to stop automatic right-panel opening after an approval action, as documented in its README and plugin client/package metadata.

summaries.zh: 这是一个面向 DSH Web GUI 的插件，在审批对话框中提供“本次会话允许”选项并按会话与模式记住授权结果，同时在审批后阻止右侧面板被自动弹开。
summaries.en: This is a DSH Web GUI plugin that adds an “Allow for this session” approval choice, remembers mode-level grants per session, and suppresses automatic right-panel opening after approval actions.

capabilities: Adds an approval-dialog option to grant a mode for the current session.
Auto-approves repeated escalation requests of the same mode within that session.
Prevents an automatically triggered right-side panel from staying open immediately after approval actions.

reasons.code: The plugin is described as adding a session-scoped “Allow for this session” option to the approval dialog and storing per-mode grants.
The plugin uses localStorage key dsh.sessionAllow.v1 with session-scoped keys (mode:<mode>) and optional per-request revocation via UI chips.
The package manifest declares a web client bundle with browser-facing injection, confirming client-side behavior and UI/interaction logic.
